import re def find_html_tags(html_string: str): """ Extract all HTML tags from the given string. Parameters ---------- html_string : str The input HTML content. Returns ------- list[str] A list of tag strings, e.g. ['
', '', '

']. """ if not isinstance(html_string, str): # Gracefully handle non-string input return [] # Regular expression to capture anything that starts with '<' and ends with '>' # It also ensures we don't accidentally match strings across newlines by using DOTALL tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+>', flags=re.DOTALL) # Find all non-overlapping matches tags = tag_pattern.findall(html_string) return tags
